question: Using a graph showing SVG's export earnings by product, a student notices arrowroot earnings fell sharply while tourism rose. What does this MOST LIKELY reflect?
options: A structural shift in the economy from agriculture toward services and tourism over recent decades
Arrowroot became more popular
Tourism earnings fell
None of the above

question: Which of the following BEST explains the concept of opportunity cost for a Caribbean government?
options: When the government spends money on one thing such as a new hospital it cannot spend that same money on something else such as roads requiring careful prioritisation
Governments can always spend on everything simultaneously
Opportunity cost only applies to businesses
None of the above

question: Which of the following BEST describes how education contributes to reducing poverty in the Caribbean?
options: Education provides skills and qualifications that increase earning potential helping individuals and families break the cycle of poverty over generations
Education has no impact on poverty
Only tertiary education reduces poverty
None of the above

question: Which of the following BEST explains why Caribbean farmers are increasingly practising organic agriculture?
options: Organic farming protects soil health, reduces chemical pollution, can command higher prices internationally and meets growing consumer demand
Organic farming produces lower yields than chemical farming with no compensating benefits
Organic farming is only possible on large farms
None of the above

question: Which of the following BEST describes what community resilience means in the context of Caribbean natural disasters?
options: The ability of a community to prepare for, withstand, recover from and adapt after a natural disaster drawing on local knowledge, cooperation and resources
Communities cannot build resilience to natural disasters
Only government can build disaster resilience
None of the above

question: Which of the following BEST describes how the Internet has both helped and challenged Caribbean education?
options: It has expanded access to learning resources globally but also brought challenges like misinformation, cyberbullying and unequal access creating a digital divide
The internet has only improved education
The internet has only harmed education
None of the above

question: Which of the following BEST explains why Caribbean nations promote regional identity alongside national identity?
options: Because Caribbean peoples share history, culture and challenges and a strong regional identity gives small states more power and purpose collectively
Regional identity replaces national identity
National identity is more important than regional identity
None of the above

question: Which of the following BEST describes how sustainable fishing practices protect Caribbean livelihoods?
options: By preventing overfishing sustainable practices ensure fish populations recover so fishing communities can continue to earn their living for generations
Sustainable fishing reduces catch so much it destroys fishing communities
All fishing is automatically sustainable
None of the above

question: Which of the following BEST explains the connection between health and national productivity?
options: Healthy citizens are more productive in school and work contributing more to economic output and national development
Health has no connection to productivity
Only mental health matters for productivity
None of the above

question: Which of the following BEST describes how deforestation in SVG threatens water security?
options: Forests act as water catchments; losing them reduces water storage, increases runoff and can cause both flooding and dry-season water shortages
Deforestation has no effect on water availability in SVG
Only urban areas face water security challenges
None of the above

question: Which of the following BEST explains why civic participation beyond voting strengthens Caribbean democracy?
options: Community involvement, peaceful advocacy and engaging with representatives creates an active citizenry that holds government continuously accountable not just at election time
Voting every five years is sufficient civic participation
Citizens have no role between elections
None of the above

question: Which of the following BEST describes what integrated pest management means for Caribbean farmers?
options: Using a combination of biological, cultural and minimal chemical methods to control pests in ways that protect the environment and human health
Using as many pesticides as possible
Allowing pests to destroy crops naturally
None of the above

question: Which of the following BEST explains the importance of the Caribbean to the global tourism industry?
options: The Caribbean is one of the world's top tourist destinations attracting millions of visitors annually with its natural beauty culture and warm climate
The Caribbean is only a minor tourist destination
Caribbean tourism only serves regional visitors
None of the above

question: Which of the following BEST describes what human development means beyond just economic growth?
options: Improving people's health, education, rights and overall quality of life so they can live long fulfilling and creative lives
Human development only means increasing GDP
Only economic factors measure development
None of the above

question: Which of the following BEST describes the role of international organisations like the United Nations in supporting Caribbean development?
options: Providing technical assistance, funding, advocacy for small island states and frameworks for addressing global challenges like climate change and poverty
The UN controls Caribbean governments
International organisations have no role in Caribbean development
None of the above
